Rule pack — cross-field and relational consistency

Source: R/rules_consistency.R
make_rule_pack_consistency.Rd

Builds executable FlagRule objects for the cross-field and relational consistency checks from the core observability rule catalog.

Usage

make_rule_pack_consistency(
  domain,
  key_vars,
  subject_var = "USUBJID",
  group_var = "SITEID",
  impossible_combos = list(),
  inconsistent_pairs = list(),
  categorical_vars = character(),
  seq_vars = character(),
  placeholder_patterns = NULL,
  max_distinct_values = 50L,
  record_count_iqr_multiplier = 3,
  owner_team = "Standards",
  ...
)

Arguments

domain

Domain name targeted by the rules.

key_vars

Character vector of key variables.

subject_var

Subject identifier variable. Default "USUBJID".

group_var

Group identifier variable. Default "SITEID".

impossible_combos

List of named character vectors that define forbidden combinations. Each element should be a named vector where names are column names and values are the forbidden values that must not appear together, e.g. list(c(SEX = "M", PREGNANT = "Y")).

inconsistent_pairs

List of named character vectors specifying values that are mutually exclusive within the same record, e.g. list(c(AESER = "Y", AESDTH = "N", AESLIFE = "N", AESHOSP = "N", AESDISAB = "N", AESCONG = "N", AESMIE = "N")). A record is flagged when all listed values match simultaneously.

categorical_vars

Character variables to inspect for unusual cardinality (R045).

seq_vars

Character vector of integer sequence variables to check for gaps or duplicates within each subject (R047).

placeholder_patterns

Character vector of regex patterns that identify placeholder text (e.g. "^N/A$", "^TBD$"). Defaults to a built-in set covering common data-entry placeholders.

max_distinct_values

Maximum number of distinct values allowed per categorical variable before R045 fires. Default 50L.

record_count_iqr_multiplier

IQR multiplier for the per-subject record count outlier check (R048). Default 3.0.

owner_team

Team assigned to follow up on flagged records.

...

Reserved for future extensions; currently ignored.

Value

A list of FlagRule objects compatible with run_flags().

Details

Rule IDNameScope
R040Impossible categorical combinationsRecord
R041Inconsistent categorical pairsRecord
R043Placeholder text prevalence spikeRecord
R045Unexpected explosion in distinct categorical valuesSnapshot
R047Sequence gaps or duplicate sequence numbersGroup
R048Record count per subject outlierGroup

Examples

pack <- make_rule_pack_consistency(
  domain            = "ADVS",
  key_vars          = c("USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVISIT"),
  categorical_vars  = c("PARAMCD", "AVISIT"),
  seq_vars          = character()
)
length(pack)
#> [1] 3
